title: Treaty of Żurawno
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Żurawno", at revision 1318794903, opens: "The Treaty of Żurawno was signed on 17 October 1676 in the town of Żurawno, in the aftermath of the Battle of Żurawno." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1779177, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "polish-ottoman treaty of 1676". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
